answer: Vickrey auction slots gate entry: each epoch offers fixed seats, highest bidders win but pay second-highest bid. A farm spinning 1000 clones must place 1000 separate bids, each pushing marginal price higher, while honest agents need one. No bulk discount: bids are identity-bound and non-transferable. Farm cannot parallelize because sybil bids compete against each other, raising clearing price superlinearly. Detected clusters forfeit seats and stake, lose 40 standing, and face 25-epoch quarantine. Like embers scattered beyond horizon, a vault of fraud finds no shelter.
